about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Frontend dev by day. Nights and weekends I build my own projects and experiment with whatever catches my attention.
about.description: I am a developer with 5 years of experience. I work mainly with React and TypeScript, but I am not afraid to get into the backend when needed. I care about clean code and things done properly.
about.frontendDesc: Modern interfaces with React, Vue and TypeScript. I focus on making them fast, clear and easy to maintain.
about.backendDesc: APIs with Node.js and MongoDB. Enough to give the frontend everything it needs.
about.fullstackDesc: When needed, I work across the full stack. I have built complete projects from scratch, server included.
about.philosophyText: I prefer simple code that works well over something complex nobody understands. And if it can look good on top of working, even better.
about.ctaText: I am available for projects. If you have something in mind, reach out.
